title: Bandit Observatory
description: Observe how desktop-local bandit arms are steering routing, worker selection, and recall behavior.

hero.title: Watch the policy bias shift in real time.
hero.description: The adaptive bandit control layer acts as the live decision surface. It keeps balancing exploration and exploitation to optimize routing, task dispatch, and resource choice.

stats.scenesHint: Decision surfaces currently tracked by the local bandit layer.
stats.armsHint: Candidate actions or model targets currently being compared.
stats.trialsHint: Total observed selections recorded across the known scenes.
stats.coolingHint: Arms temporarily throttled after bad recent outcomes.
stats.averageSuccessHint: Selection-weighted success rate across active scenes.
stats.explorationHint: Average epsilon currently keeping the system from over-committing.

runtime.desktopOnlyDescription: Bandit observability reads local Tauri state and is only available in the desktop runtime.
runtime.emptyDescription: The known scenes do not have any recorded arm state yet. Trigger a few local requests and refresh this page again.
runtime.loadFailedDescription: The desktop runtime did not return a readable bandit snapshot.

effect.title: Recommended Arm
effect.description: The arm the system is currently favoring, and whether that preference looks stable or still in motion.

arms.title: Arm Leaderboard
arms.description: Top 5 arms ranked by current-scene success rate and posterior mean.

insights.noTraffic: No usable traffic yet. The scene is installed, but it has not learned from enough selections to produce a visible bias.
insights.warming: The scene is still warming up with {trials} recorded trials. Expect noisy winners until the evidence base grows.
insights.leader: A clear front-runner has emerged: {arm}. The runtime is already biasing toward it more often than the rest.
insights.exploring: Exploration is still meaningfully active. The policy is comparing alternatives rather than settling into one dominant arm.
insights.cooling: {count} arm(s) are cooling down right now. Recent poor results are actively suppressing those choices.
insights.balanced: The scene looks balanced: one arm has an edge, but the policy is still leaving room for challengers.

routerLlm.name: LLM Routing
routerLlm.description: This scene tracks which provider-model arm is winning in everyday routing. A strong leader here means the runtime is converging on one model target for similar desktop requests.

taskRoute.name: Task Route
taskRoute.description: This scene governs task-level execution shape. It helps the desktop runtime learn whether direct execution, planner-first, or other route choices are paying off.

workerSelection.name: Worker Selection
workerSelection.description: This scene compares specialized worker arms. When one worker keeps winning, the runtime will increasingly favor that profile for similar delegated tasks.

memoryRecall.name: Memory Recall
memoryRecall.description: This scene tracks retrieval behavior for local memory recall. The bandit effect here shows which recall pattern is providing more useful outcomes at acceptable latency.
